tools.name: schedule_reminder
tools.description: Schedule, list, retrieve or cancel a personal Pushary reminder for the authenticated user. Scheduled reminders can arrive after the agent exits. One-time only; up to 30 days away, 25 pending per user/site. Scheduling requires body and either inMinutes or at with an explicit UTC offset. requestId ide

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Send a notification to connected devices for a requested update or a meaningful unattended result, such as a finished task. tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Ask for an unresolved decision or missing input. Prefer this over an in-app question when the user requests Pushary or mobile contact, is away, or work is unattended. tools.name: propose_scope
tools.description: Request agreement on an unresolved or user-requested boundary for this session. Sends a real scope question and returns ratified, answered, contract and enforcement information.
